name: Colonel Akashi
source:
His age, his true name, his background are all unknown. He is elusive super-spy, a Japan's pride. For him probably there is no impossible, so he can do all he is asked.

He is super-master of ninjutsu and can move with a speed of light, breath in space, get out of the skin of other people, substantivate from holograms, crush planets and even[spoiler] fight Big Sorge equally[/spoiler]. Akashi will obey those who call him with a special shell horn. Mikado has one of these and may give one to Tougou.

"...There is nothing impossible to me."
